Roborock will hold its autumn Prime Day promotion from October 6 to 7, with substantial discounts on its 2026 flagship robot vacuums and other products. Below are the details of Roborock's limited-time deep discounts, and which product is right for you.

Roborock's 2026 product lineup launches discounts of up to $1,600 during autumn Prime Day, covering models for different needs

One of the great benefits of technology is that it saves us time. When tech products can take care of household chores for you, why spend your precious life on home cleaning?

Roborock has always been a leader in using technology to create futuristic products, with its range of robot vacuums and robot mops covering every household need and budget.

Starting today, Roborock launches its autumn Prime Day promotion, with limited-time discounts on its 2026 flagship product lineup. Here is a look at the discounted products and the strengths of each:

Roborock Qrevo Edge 3 Pro: All-round convenience and powerful performance

If you have a busy household and a hectic pace of life, the Roborock Qrevo Edge 3 Pro's automation features free you from the hassle of cleaning and managing cleaning products. The Qrevo Edge 3 Pro does not need constant supervision. Its top-of-the-line AdaptiLift® chassis 3.0 can cross single-layer thresholds up to 1.77 inches and double-layer thresholds up to 3.46 inches, and can also reach into spaces as low as 3.13 inches for cleaning. The 36,000 Pa HyperForce® suction motor and dual anti-tangle system can handle all kinds of dirt on the floor, and with enhanced warm-water mopping, you get a complete all-round clean.

The Qrevo Edge 3 Pro can also intelligently recognise over 300 objects, so you don't have to keep tidying up before cleaning. The powerful battery can clean nearly 350 square metres on a single charge, and the multifunction dock features full self-cleaning automation. The common pain points of robot vacuums are simply not an issue here.

Roborock Saros 20: A more accessible premium smart choice for autumn Prime Day

If you're after the most advanced smart performance while enjoying the top-tier features of the Qrevo Edge 3 Pro, the Roborock Saros 20 is made for you. The Saros 20 is equipped with the Qrevo series' powerful features, including the AdaptiLift® chassis 3.0, 36,000 Pa HyperForce® suction motor and dual anti-tangle system, along with even more powerful smart technology. The StarSight Autonomous System 2.0, Smart Reach and Smart Plan 3.0 work together to deliver ultra-precise navigation that minimises missed areas, seamless edge cleaning, and AI smart control at your fingertips. The Saros 20's ultra-slim design reaches into low-clearance spaces as shallow as 3.13 inches, and like the Qrevo Edge 3 Pro, it comes with a fully automatic dock for hands-free self-cleaning.

Taking advantage of the autumn Prime Day offer, the Saros 20's premium smart cleaning experience is now available at a more accessible price.

Roborock Qrevo 2 Pro: Outstanding value with plenty of power

If you want to upgrade your home cleaning experience on a limited budget, the Roborock Qrevo 2 Pro is an excellent value choice. It comes with top-tier features such as FlexiArm Edge mopping and corner cleaning, Smart Carpet Care intelligent carpet care, plus a powerful 20,000 Pa suction and dual zero-tangle system for deep cleaning on all types of floors. Despite its accessible price, it still comes with a fully automatic self-cleaning dock with auto dust emptying, water refilling, hot-water mop washing and warm-air drying. Reactive Tech navigation and SmartPlan 3.0 ensure the robot vacuum can avoid 3D obstacles, reducing interruptions during cleaning.

Roborock F25 Steam: Deep steam cleaning for stubborn stains

Roborock also offers handheld wet-and-dry vacuums through the F25 series. The Roborock F25 Steam is designed for deep steam cleaning to tackle stubborn stains around the home, making it especially suitable for households with pets or young children. Its 356°F VaporFlow steam removes the toughest stains without harsh chemicals. The powerful 25,000 Pa suction combined with JawScrapers anti-tangle technology handles dry and wet messes, pet hair and more with zero hair tangles. The 180° FlatReach 2.0 and blue-light illumination let you reach into hard-to-access spots and illuminate dirt that might otherwise be missed.

The F25 Steam's battery provides up to 80 minutes of runtime, and it comes with a 1,000 ml clean water tank, meaning a single charge can cover over 7,000 square feet. With heat-activated self-cleaning and 203°F hot-air drying, maintenance needs are minimal.

Roborock F25 XT: Quick and easy handling of everyday spills and accidents

The Roborock F25 XT is equipped with SlideTech™ 2.0 wheels, making it smoother and easier to glide from room to room. Its compact design makes it easy to grab and store, so you can quickly deal with everyday messes. The F25 XT has a powerful 20,000 Pa suction and a FlatLay design that reaches under low furniture. The dual scraping system ensures no water streaks after cleaning, and triple edge cleaning combined with flexible manoeuvrability makes rotating and cleaning in tight spaces effortless. It features built-in high-temperature self-cleaning and 194°F quick drying, plus an automatic detergent dispensing system that adjusts according to the level of dirt.

Roborock F25 Ultra Steam Gen 2: The ultimate versatile all-in-one cleaner

The Roborock F25 Ultra Steam Gen 2 officially goes on sale on October 8, but you can pre-order it now with the autumn Prime Day discount. This new powerful model features 356°F steam cleaning and 187°F hot-water washing to remove stubborn stains, with 25,000 Pa of suction. It also comes with an auto-lifting mechanical arm for seamless edge cleaning while leaving virtually no water streaks on the floor. A single charge delivers 100 minutes of runtime, and it comes with a self-cleaning dock with automatic detergent dispensing. The SlideTech 2.0 AI-enhanced gliding wheels make pushing and pulling smooth and effortless, so you can move around the home with ease.

Whether you're buying your first robot vacuum or considering upgrading your existing robot vacuum or handheld vacuum, Roborock's autumn Prime Day offers are a great time to make your purchase.
